requirement:
HC's validation policy requires each issue linked by a FIXME to remain open.
A deterministic criterion reads the issue through the SDK's tracked inspection
interface and assesses its supplied status. `Closed` produces a completed
failing assessment; `Open` satisfies this status check. The check does not
require a configured agent.
rationale:
`requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.open` requires a deterministic criterion to read the issue through the SDK's tracked inspection interface. `Closed` must produce a completed failing assessment, `Open` must satisfy the status check, and no configured agent may be needed.

The `references` tool finds no `{test}`, `{impl}` or `{cite}` sites for this requirement. No test covers any of these obligations: closed giving a completed failing assessment, open passing, or running without an agent. That is a real test gap.

The gap is acknowledged. `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` has a `{fixme}` reference to exactly `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.open`. Its body says the open-issue criterion is deferred and that tests don't yet verify completed open/closed assessments through the SDK without an agent. That matches the gap I found. The issue it names, `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26`, is open, so the acknowledgment is valid.
